title: Zhou Yi Becomes Ascendant
summary: Wang Lin attacks the exhausted Hongdie, and when her bracelet starts to carry her back to the Suzaku Country he distracts her with the Seven Feather Fan of the Snow Region and cuts off one of her arms, planning to curse her through it. Trapped because the Return Furnace cannot work in overlapping fragments, he and Chi Hu go down to a fourth layer, a palace built of immortal jade. There Zhou Yi, burning his soul, wins against Sun Tai, reaches Ascendant in his last moments and remembers his past: the Celestial corpse had forced the obsession on him. He asks Wang Lin to care for his wife for a thousand years, a thousand immortal jades every thousand years, and pays him with three gifts: a pagoda holding his Ascendant domain, an Ascendant Crystal, and Sun Tai as Wang Lin's slave for a thousand years. Then Zhou Yi calls out the first Rain Celestial Sword, and the Celestial woman awakens and names him her sword spirit.

changes: Indonesian fansubs read in full; key lines spot-checked against the official English (YouTube), which arrived late.
'Kerajaan Vermilion' = Suzaku Country; 'Kipas Tujuh Bulu, Negara Daerah Salju' = Seven Feather Fan of Xue Yue.
flags: 269-289: Hongdie names Wang Lin's domain 'Waktu' (official English: 'years', 'the artistic conception of time'); probably his Life and Death domain.
1104-1111: the slave seal lets Wang Lin destroy Sun Tai's soul with a thought; official English 'this transformation of infant powerhouse' = Soul Transformation expert.
1212-1224: the speaker who names Zhou Yi sword spirit is read as Ting'er (the awakened Celestial).
